questions.question: What did Pachacuti do to regions he wanted in his empire before conquering them?

answer_explanations: Correct. The article states, 'Pachacuti sent spies to regions he wanted in his empire... He then sent messages to their leaders extolling the benefits of joining his empire, offering them presents of luxury goods.'
Incorrect. The article says that most leaders 'acquiesced peacefully' after receiving messages and gifts; military conquest only followed refusal.
Incorrect. Building roads was a feature of the empire, but it is not described as a strategy used by Pachacuti to win over regions.
